verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs cover reviewing changes before merge. Bugbot automatically reviews pull requests for bugs, security issues, and code quality problems. Cloud agents verify their changes and attach screenshots, videos, and logs to the PR so you can validate without checking out the branch. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the in-editor diff-inspection UI (only a one-line docs heading), independent or hands-on corroboration of review and check effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge
Bugbot reviews pull requests and identifies bugs, security issues, and code quality problems
Agents can start dev servers, open the app in a browser, click through UI flows, and verify their changes work before pushing a PR.
These artifacts are attached to the PR so you can quickly validate changes without checking out the branch locally.
